comparison: Rejected drawing had large goggle-like rings joined by a bar across a round head and a banded shirt; it read as goggles, not the original's balaclava with eye and mouth holes over a continuous head-and-neck silhouette.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. One mask outline flowing from crown into the neck and hem, with two eye holes and a mouth hole; matches the reference silhouette at 48.
omissions: Hole outlines (rings cannot keep 8 apart in a 26-wide head; drawn as dots) and the chin seam.
human_reference: icon_set/references/human_ref/user.svg; balaclava head and neck form one continuous outline (true anatomical connection), so no detached head gap applies.
